title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager: AI-powered regulatory templates from regulation PDFs
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, PDF creation procedure, access controls and licensing qualifications are supported. Microsoft documents all three Add commands flagged by the pre-check. The checklist's instruction to review overall Compliance Manager roles has no corresponding control row, a minor presentation gap.

claims.claim: The roadmap names AI-powered regulatory templates in Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager - AI Powered Regulatory Templates

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to convert regulation PDFs to actionable controls and actions in a multicloud environment.
claims.quote: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to convert complex regulations from PDF documents to actionable controls and actions in multi cloud environment.

claims.claim: Customers can use the converted templates to create assessments, identify compliance gaps and implement controls.
claims.quote: Customers can use the converted regulatory templates to create assessments and identify compliance gaps, understand and implement controls to improve their compliance posture.

The PDF creation route is Microsoft Purview portal > Compliance Manager > Regulations > Create new template > Upload PDF document > Scan and extract > Review draft template > Publish template.
claims.quote: From your Regulations page, select Create new template. ... Select Upload PDF document. ... Select Scan and extract. ... When the scan is complete, select Review draft template. ... When you're satisfied, select Publish template.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API or automation for PDF regulation-template creation at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Compliance Manager" regulation template create upload API PowerShell Security Compliance'; opened compliance-manager-create-template, compliance-manager-regulations and compliance-manager-setup. Results describe portal creation, not a PDF creation operation.

claims.claim: The access route is Microsoft Purview portal > Compliance Manager > Regulations > regulation > Manage user access > role > Add readers / Add assessors / Add contributors.
claims.quote: From the Regulations page ... Select it to open its details page. ... select Manage user access. ... Navigate to the tab for the role ... Select the + Add command for the role tab you're on: Add readers, or Add assessors or Add contributors.

claims.claim: No API is documented for assigning per-regulation assessment-access roles.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Compliance Manager" regulation "Manage user access" API PowerShell' and 'Compliance Manager Manage user access regulation permissions PowerShell Security Compliance New RoleGroupMember API'; opened regulations and setup. General role-group cmdlets do not document per-regulation assignments.

claims.claim: No tenant UI switch or API to turn PDF template creation on or off is documented in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Compliance Manager" "PDF" disable enable default tenant settings' and '"Compliance Manager" regulation template create upload API PowerShell Security Compliance'; opened setup and create-template. Settings and search results document no PDF availability switch.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the roadmap feature's default on arrival or that existing behaviour changes without action.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Compliance Manager" "PDF" disable enable default tenant settings'; read roadmap description, create-template and setup. PDF creation is an admin procedure; none states rollout defaults or an automatic change to existing behaviour for this roadmap capability.

claims.claim: No administrator action is stated as required for the roadmap change.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Compliance Manager" "PDF" disable enable default tenant settings'; read roadmap record and create-template. Neither specifies required rollout action. The supplied pre-check contains no Message Center post.

claims.quote: Searched: '"Compliance Manager" "PDF" "license" custom regulation templates pricing'; read the entire create-template page. Its Requirements section lists Administration or Assessor and an official regulation PDF; no licence, price or meter is named.

claims.claim: Regulation licenses used tracks templates in use against the number the organisation is eligible to use.

claims.claim: The Get started page names Free regulation licenses used/Purchased regulation licenses used counters.
